The duo that STRIKES 🔥

🚨🎙️| Fermín: "I'm very grateful to Xavi because he gave me the opportunity to play for the first team and, above all, he helped me gain the confidence to play my game, to develop my own style. he gave me the confidence to develop that style and show my QUALITIES on the pitch." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Fermín: "With Flick I've been able to acquire that MATURITY to read the game, the moments, the plays, knowing when to act and when not to. Before, I was a bit too focused, sometimes rushing things, but with him, and also with time and playing matches, you gradually learn that." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Fermín: "Competition with Olmo? It's really GOOD because he's a very good player, and in the end, we both try to make the most of our opportunities and do what's best for ourselves. But we get along really well off the field. The competition makes us BETTER every day, and I think that's important." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Fermín: "We weren't sharp against Real Madrid, but there's still a long way to go in La Liga and we'll achieve GREAT things. PSG are flying, but the defeat wasn't a disaster and they're NOT light years ahead." #fcblive
